facts.fact: The WMO-hosted METTELSAT document says the agency has PUMA 2015 and MESSIR NEO equipment connected to the EUMETCast Africa data stream to receive satellite images and regional and global model data.
The MeteoSwiss peer review says METTELSAT has a functional PUMA satellite reception system at its headquarters giving access to EUMETCast.
The review says METTELSAT forecasters assemble the daily next-day forecast for the major cities manually, primarily from ARPEGE and GFS model material and METEOSAT images.
